query:
SELECT au.id, au.email, au.tokenBalance, au.createdAt, au.lastLoginAt,
       ua.id as action_id, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.createdAt as action_date, ua.description
FROM app_users au
LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'ladaatn@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
